Border radius, outline and box
shadow

Border radius rounds corners; outline draws outside the border without taking layout space;
shadow paints a visual effect.
border-radius එක corners round කරනවා. outline එක layout size Jවනස් Jනාකර border එJකන්
පිටත line එකකේ දොනවා. box-shadow එක visual depth එකකේ Jදෙනවා. Focus outline ඉවතේ කරනවා
නම් Jවනතේ පෙුහුදිලි focus indicator එකකේ Jදෙන්න.

Card එJකේ වටකුරු border, පිටත shadow සහ focus outline Jවන් කරලා බලන්න.
Expected result: Rounded card and shadow; focused card shows outline without resizing.
Interview question: Does outline affect layout dimensions?
Answer: No. Unlike a border, an outline does not take layout space.
Remember: Border takes space; outline paints.
